card.name: Linking words before progestin names
card.fires_on: The word just before a named drug in an estrogen plus progestin pairing, such as 'combined with' or 'plus' before medroxyprogesterone or MPA. It also fires on the first letter or two of a drug name that follows.

modes.label: Estrogen plus progestin link
modes.description: A linking word like with or plus right after an estrogen dose, before the progestin name.
modes.example: daily oral CE (0.625 mg) combined<< with>> medroxyprogesterone acetate

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first letters of a drug name that comes next in a list.

modes.label: Dose unit before a partner drug
modes.description: A unit like mg after a dose, just before the partner drug abbreviation.
modes.example: 0.625 mg CE and 2.5<< mg>> MPA were studied

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting a drug name or word piece that comes next, not any one clear word.
card.plain: It lights up at the small word or first letters that lead into a hormone drug name, like 'with' before medroxyprogesterone.
